title: Children's Online Safety Request Letter Template
metaDescription: Free template to request enhanced online safety measures for your child from schools, websites, and service providers. COPPA-compliant protection.
description: A comprehensive letter template for parents to formally request enhanced online safety measures, privacy protections, and COPPA compliance from schools, websites, and online service providers to protect their child's digital wellbeing.

sections.heading: Letter Header and Contact Information
Opening Statement and Child Information
sections.content:
Dear {{recipient_name}},

I am writing to formally request enhanced online safety measures for my child, {{child_name}}, who is {{child_age}} years old and {{child_details}}. As a parent concerned about children's online privacy and safety, I am requesting your organization implement specific protections in accordance with COPPA (Children's Online Privacy Protection Act) and best practices for child internet safety.

sections.heading: Specific Safety Requests
sections.content:
I respectfully request the following online safety measures be implemented:

• Content Filtering: Ensure all internet access includes age-appropriate content filtering to block inappropriate websites, violent content, and adult material
• Safe Browser Usage: Implement secure browsers like a privacy-focused browser or other privacy-focused browsers that limit tracking and data collection
• Communication Monitoring: Monitor and restrict online communication features to prevent contact with unknown individuals
• Data Collection Limits: Minimize collection of my child's personal information and ensure COPPA compliance for any data gathered
• {{custom_request_1}}
• {{custom_request_2}}

sections.heading: COPPA Compliance Requirements
sections.content:
Under the Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA), I request confirmation that:

• No personal information is collected from my child without explicit parental consent
• Any collected data is used only for educational/legitimate purposes
• My child's information is not shared with third parties without my written permission
• I have the right to review and delete any information collected about my child
• Appropriate security measures protect my child's data from unauthorized access

Please provide written confirmation of your COPPA compliance procedures and how they apply to {{child_name}}.

sections.heading: Parental Control and Monitoring Rights
sections.content:
As {{child_name}}'s parent, I request:

• Regular reports on my child's online activities and any safety incidents
• Immediate notification if inappropriate content is accessed or if safety concerns arise
• The ability to adjust safety settings and restrictions as needed
• Access to review any digital communications or submissions made by my child
• {{additional_monitoring_request}}

I am committed to working collaboratively to ensure my child's online safety while supporting their educational and developmental needs.

sections.heading: Closing and Next Steps
sections.content:
I appreciate your attention to these important safety matters. Please respond within {{response_timeframe}} with:

• Confirmation of which safety measures can be implemented
• Timeline for implementing requested protections
• Your current online safety policies and COPPA compliance procedures
• Contact information for ongoing safety concerns

I look forward to working together to create a safe online environment for {{child_name}}. Please contact me at {{parent_phone}} or {{parent_email}} if you need any additional information.

Sincerely,

{{parent_name}}
Parent/Guardian of {{child_name}}

useCases: Requesting enhanced internet safety measures from your child's school
Asking online platforms to implement COPPA-compliant protections for your child
Requesting content filtering and monitoring from educational technology providers
Seeking parental control options from internet service providers
Asking daycare centers or after-school programs to improve online safety protocols
